summary.zh-CN: 一位服降压药的退休巴士车长来到新加坡的社区中医诊所，饭后胃胀两个月。完成评估与方案，回应药房的审方意见，并在两周后复诊。
summary.en: A retired bus captain on blood-pressure tablets comes to a community TCM clinic in Singapore after two months of fullness after meals. Assess him, plan his care, answer the dispensary's query, and see him again in two weeks.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 筛查消化不良的报警症状，并按年龄（60岁或以上）经家庭医生转介胃镜，不过度也不遗漏。
learningOutcomes.en: Screen dyspepsia for alarm features and refer through the GP for endoscopy by age (60 or over), neither over- nor under-reacting.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 辨为脾胃气虚、湿阻气滞，并与胃阴不足、肝胃不和、脾胃湿热相鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Differentiate spleen–stomach qi deficiency with damp and qi stagnation from stomach yin deficiency, liver–stomach disharmony and spleen–stomach damp-heat.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 就具体病人的风险回应药房的审方意见：识别甘草与噻嗪类利尿剂相加的假性醛固酮增多症风险，以新版本处方修改，而不是以“在药典范围内”驳回。
learningOutcomes.en: Answer a dispensary query on the patient's own risk: recognise liquorice's pseudo-aldosteronism risk added to a thiazide, and revise with a new prescription version rather than overruling with "within the Pharmacopoeia range".

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 改自己的处方，与家庭医生协调，不停用他开的降压药。
learningOutcomes.en: Change your own prescription and coordinate with the GP, without stopping the antihypertensive the GP prescribed.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 复诊时监测出现担心的效应，要在食物、饮料与保健品中寻找隐藏来源（凉茶、甘草梅），并当天告知家庭医生。
learningOutcomes.en: At review, when monitoring shows the feared effect, look for hidden sources in foods, drinks and supplements (herbal tea, liquorice plums) and tell the GP the same day.

name.zh-CN: 药房对处方第1版的审方意见
name.en: Dispensary query on prescription version 1

text.zh-CN:
审方人：蔡女士（中药调剂）。处方第1版暂缓调剂，请处方医师回应：
方中炙甘草6 g/日。患者63岁，服氢氯噻嗪（排钾利尿剂），今日血压148/88 mmHg，三个月前血钾3.5 mmol/L（偏低边缘）。甘草所含甘草酸可致假性醛固酮增多症（水钠潴留、失钾、血压升高），与噻嗪类利尿剂的失钾作用相加，风险随剂量与疗程增加。欧盟食品科学委员会（2003）建议甘草酸日常摄入不超过约100 mg，高血压等敏感人群可能更低；按产品不同，6 g炙甘草可接近或超过此量。建议去掉甘草，或减至3 g以下并安排血压与血钾监测；如维持原剂量，请书面说明理由。
text.en:
Reviewer: Ms Chua (TCM dispensing). Prescription version 1 is on hold pending the prescriber's response:
The formula has 炙甘草 (prepared liquorice) 6 g/day. The patient is 63 and takes hydrochlorothiazide (a potassium-losing diuretic); his blood pressure today is 148/88 mmHg and his potassium three months ago was 3.5 mmol/L (low-normal). The glycyrrhizic acid in liquorice can cause pseudo-aldosteronism (sodium and water retention, potassium loss, higher blood pressure), adding to the thiazide's potassium loss; the risk rises with dose and duration. The EU Scientific Committee on Food (2003) suggested regular intake of glycyrrhizic acid should not exceed about 100 mg a day, and sensitive people, such as those with high blood pressure, may react to less; depending on the product, 6 g of 炙甘草 can approach or exceed that. Suggest omitting the liquorice, or reducing it to 3 g or less with blood-pressure and potassium monitoring; if the dose is kept, please give the reason in writing.

source.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例：由编者撰写。

name.zh-CN: 家庭医生的验血结果与回信（复诊）
name.en: GP's blood results and reply (review)

date.zh-CN: 两天前（综合诊所，黄医生）

text.zh-CN: 钾3.3 mmol/L（偏低），钠141 mmol/L，肌酐94 µmol/L。诊所血压154/92 mmHg。已按转介信安排胃镜（结果见另页）。随信附来的中药处方第2版已收悉。请中医诊所核查他的全部甘草来源，包括处方以外的。
text.en: Potassium 3.3 mmol/L (low), sodium 141 mmol/L, creatinine 94 µmol/L. Clinic blood pressure 154/92 mmHg. Endoscopy arranged from your letter (report attached separately). Herbal prescription version 2, as attached to your letter, noted. Please check all his sources of liquorice, including any outside the prescription.

note.zh-CN: 参考范围为示例，以检验机构报告为准。
note.en: Reference ranges are illustrative; the laboratory's own report governs.

source.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例：由编者撰写。

name.zh-CN: 胃镜报告
name.en: Endoscopy report

text.zh-CN: 食管正常。胃窦轻度红斑，无溃疡、无肿物；十二指肠正常。快速尿素酶试验阴性。胃窦与胃体活检：轻度慢性胃炎，未见幽门螺杆菌，无肠化生或异型增生。
text.en: Oesophagus normal. Mild antral erythema, no ulcer or mass; duodenum normal. Rapid urease test negative. Antral and body biopsies: mild chronic gastritis, no Helicobacter pylori, no intestinal metaplasia or dysplasia.

source.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例：由编者撰写。

name.zh-CN: 他带来的两周家庭血压记录
name.en: His two-week home blood-pressure log

text.zh-CN: 第一周平均142/86 mmHg；第二周逐日上升，平均152/92 mmHg。
text.en: Week 1 average 142/86 mmHg; week 2 rising day by day, average 152/92 mmHg.

source.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例：由编者撰写。

name.zh-CN: 说明评估与方案（含胃镜转介、替代方案、获益与风险），取得并记录知情同意
name.en: Explain the assessment and plan (with the endoscopy referral, alternatives, benefits and risks) and record his consent

dose.zh-CN: 说明：60岁以上新出现的消化不良建议照胃镜排除严重疾病，由家庭医生转介；他没有报警症状，不需要急诊；中药可同时调理脾胃；可能的不良反应。
dose.en: Explain that new indigestion at 60 or over calls for an endoscopy to rule out serious disease, arranged by his GP; that he has no alarm features, so this is not an emergency; that herbs can treat the digestion meanwhile; and the possible side effects.

response.zh-CN: 他松了一口气：“先照胃镜放心，中药也一起吃，好。”
response.en: He looks relieved: "A scope first for peace of mind, and the herbs too — all right."

name.zh-CN: 提交中药处方第1版：香砂六君子汤加减
name.en: Submit herbal prescription version 1: modified Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang

dose.zh-CN: 香砂六君子汤加减配方颗粒，以饮片当量计（克/日）：党参15、白术12、茯苓15、炙甘草6、陈皮9、法半夏9、木香6、砂仁6。每日1剂分2包，午饭后及晚饭后各1包，温水冲服，共14天（28包）。
dose.en: Modified Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang (香砂六君子汤) as concentrated granules, crude-herb equivalents (g/day): 党参 Codonopsis Radix 15, 白术 Atractylodis Macrocephalae Rhizoma 12, 茯苓 Poria 15, 炙甘草 Glycyrrhizae Radix et Rhizoma Praeparata cum Melle 6, 陈皮 Citri Reticulatae Pericarpium 9, 法半夏 Pinelliae Rhizoma Praeparatum 9, 木香 Aucklandiae Radix 6, 砂仁 Amomi Fructus 6. One day's dose in 2 sachets, after lunch and after dinner in warm water, for 14 days (28 sachets).

response.zh-CN: 处方第1版已提交药房审核。
response.en: Prescription version 1 has gone to the dispensary for review.

name.zh-CN: 开具处方第2版：去掉炙甘草，其余不变（处方医师签名）
name.en: Issue prescription version 2 leaving out the 炙甘草, otherwise unchanged (signed by the prescriber)

dose.zh-CN: 第2版：去掉炙甘草，其余同第1版；在处方上注明理由（服噻嗪类利尿剂、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘）；第1版作废；两周后由家庭医生复查血压与血钾。
dose.en: Version 2: 炙甘草 left out, otherwise as version 1; the reason written on the prescription (on a thiazide, blood pressure above target, low-normal potassium); version 1 cancelled; blood pressure and potassium rechecked by his GP in two weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 不能签发：先看并回应药房的审方意见；且同一时间只能有一个有效的第2版——已签发的第2版保持有效。
harm.en: Not signed: read and answer the dispensary's query first; and only one version 2 can be active — once one is signed, it stands.

response.zh-CN: 第2版（不含甘草）已签发，药房确认收到，第1版标记为作废。
response.en: Version 2 (no liquorice) is signed; the dispensary acknowledges it and marks version 1 cancelled.

name.zh-CN: 开具处方第2版：炙甘草减至3 g，并写明监测计划（处方医师签名）
name.en: Issue prescription version 2 reducing 炙甘草 to 3 g, with the monitoring plan written on it (signed by the prescriber)

dose.zh-CN: 第2版：炙甘草3 g，其余同第1版；注明理由与监测（两周后由家庭医生复查血压与血钾，出现抽筋、无力、心悸、水肿即停药联系）；第1版作废。
dose.en: Version 2: 炙甘草 3 g, otherwise as version 1; the reason and the monitoring written on it (blood pressure and potassium rechecked by his GP in two weeks; stop and call for cramps, weakness, palpitations or swelling); version 1 cancelled.

harm.zh-CN: 不能签发：先看并回应药房的审方意见；且同一时间只能有一个有效的第2版——已签发的第2版保持有效。
harm.en: Not signed: read and answer the dispensary's query first; and only one version 2 can be active — once one is signed, it stands.

response.zh-CN: 第2版（炙甘草3 g）已签发，药房确认收到，第1版标记为作废。
response.en: Version 2 (炙甘草 3 g) is signed; the dispensary acknowledges it and marks version 1 cancelled.

name.zh-CN: 回复药房：6 g在药典剂量范围内，照第1版调剂
name.en: Reply to the dispensary: 6 g is within the Pharmacopoeia range — dispense version 1 as written

harm.zh-CN: “在药典范围内”说的是一般人群，不是这位病人：他服排钾利尿剂、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘，甘草的风险与剂量、疗程相关并与利尿剂相加。审方意见要就这个病人的具体风险回答。药房不会凭这个理由放行。
harm.en: "Within the Pharmacopoeia range" is about people in general, not this patient: he takes a potassium-losing diuretic, his blood pressure is above target and his potassium is low-normal, and liquorice's risk depends on dose and duration and adds to the diuretic's. A query must be answered on this patient's risk; the dispensary will not release version 1 on that reason.

response.zh-CN: 药房仍将第1版标注为“待处理”。

name.zh-CN: 叫他吃中药期间先停氢氯噻嗪
name.en: Tell him to stop the hydrochlorothiazide while he takes the herbs

harm.zh-CN: 这是家庭医生开的降压药，血压本来就未达标：自行停用会让血压更高。要调整的是你自己的处方，并与家庭医生沟通。
harm.en: It is his GP's antihypertensive, and his blood pressure is already above target: stopping it would raise it further. What you adjust is your own prescription, and you talk to his GP.

response.zh-CN: 他犹豫地说：“综合诊所的医生说不能停……”
response.en: He hesitates: "The polyclinic doctor said never to stop it…"

name.zh-CN: 将现行版本处方交药房调剂并发药
name.en: Release the current prescription version for dispensing and supply

harm.zh-CN: 版本核对未通过：处方第1版仍有未解决的审方意见，药房不会按它发药。先回应审方意见，开具新版本处方。
harm.en: Version check failed: prescription version 1 still has an open query, and the dispensary will not supply it. Answer the query and issue a new version first.

response.zh-CN: 药房按已签发的第2版调剂了28包配方颗粒，贴好中英文标签；调剂记录注明所用版本及炙甘草的剂量（无或3 g）。
response.en: The dispensary fills 28 sachets of granules from the signed version 2 and applies a bilingual label; the dispensing record names the version and its 炙甘草 dose (none, or 3 g).

name.zh-CN: 中药用法与注意事项交代（包括甘草与血钾）
name.en: Counsel him on taking the granules and what to watch for (liquorice and potassium included)

dose.zh-CN: 午饭后、晚饭后各1包，温水冲服；血压药照常吃；不要另外吃甘草类零食或保健品；出现抽筋、无力、心跳乱或脚肿时停药并联系诊所。
dose.en: 1 sachet after lunch and 1 after dinner in warm water; keep taking his blood-pressure tablets; no liquorice sweets or supplements on top; stop and call the clinic for cramps, weakness, a fluttering heartbeat or swollen ankles.

response.zh-CN: 他点头：“甘草糖我不吃的。”
response.en: He nods: "I don't eat liquorice sweets anyway."

name.zh-CN: 写信给综合诊所的黄医生：转介胃镜，告知血压、处方第2版与甘草问题，请两周后复查血钾与血压
name.en: Write to Dr Wong at the polyclinic: endoscopy referral, his blood pressure, prescription version 2 and the liquorice question; ask for potassium and blood pressure to be checked in two weeks

harm.zh-CN: 先把处方版本定下来，转介信才能写清楚他实际要吃的是什么。
harm.en: Settle the prescription version first, so that the letter says what he will actually take.

response.zh-CN: 信已发出：63岁新发消化不良两个月、无报警症状，请转介胃镜；今日血压148/88 mmHg，服氢氯噻嗪，三个月前血钾3.5；附中药处方第2版与审方意见；请两周后复查血钾与血压。
response.en: The letter is sent: new dyspepsia for two months at 63, no alarm features, please refer for endoscopy; blood pressure 148/88 mmHg today on hydrochlorothiazide, potassium 3.5 three months ago; herbal prescription version 2 and the dispensary's query attached; please recheck potassium and blood pressure in two weeks.

name.zh-CN: 饮食建议：定时、少量、温热，少冰饮生冷与油腻，细嚼慢咽
name.en: Diet advice: regular, smaller, warm meals; fewer iced drinks, raw and greasy foods; eat slowly

response.zh-CN: 他说早上的冰咖啡乌可以改成热的。
response.en: He says he can switch his morning iced kopi-o to a hot one.

name.zh-CN: 立即转急诊
name.en: Send him to the emergency department now

response.zh-CN: 转诊单已写好。他没有出血、吞咽困难、呕吐或体重下降，生命体征平稳：没有急诊指征，按计划由家庭医生安排胃镜即可。
response.en: The referral is written. With no bleeding, difficulty swallowing, vomiting or weight loss, and stable observations, nothing calls for the emergency department; an endoscopy arranged by his GP is enough.

name.zh-CN: 预约两周后复诊，请他带家庭血压记录与家庭医生的结果
name.en: Book a review in two weeks and ask him to bring his home blood-pressure readings and his GP's results

response.zh-CN: 前台预约了两周后的同一时间。
response.en: Reception books the same time in two weeks.

name.zh-CN: 停喝廿四味等凉茶、停吃甘草梅，并说明这些都含甘草
name.en: Stop the 廿四味 herbal tea and the liquorice plums, explaining that both contain liquorice

harm.zh-CN: 先问清楚他这两个星期喝了、吃了什么新的东西。
harm.en: Find out first what new things he has been drinking and eating these two weeks.

response.zh-CN: 他很惊讶：“凉茶也有甘草？”他答应全部停掉，太太那边他会解释。
response.en: He is surprised: "Herbal tea has liquorice in it?" He agrees to stop them all, and will explain to his wife.

name.zh-CN: 当天打电话给黄医生：血钾3.3、血压上升、脚肿，已找到凉茶与甘草梅这个来源；血钾与降压药由她处理
name.en: Call Dr Wong the same day: potassium 3.3, rising blood pressure and ankle swelling, with the herbal tea and liquorice plums found as the source; she manages the potassium and the antihypertensives

harm.zh-CN: 先看家庭医生的结果，才知道要告诉她什么。
harm.en: Read the GP's results first, so that you know what to tell her.

response.zh-CN: 黄医生同意：停凉茶与甘草梅；她开一周口服氯化钾，一周后复查血钾与血压，如血钾仍低再考虑调整利尿剂。她谢谢你找到来源。
response.en: Dr Wong agrees: stop the tea and the plums. She prescribes oral potassium chloride for a week and will recheck potassium and blood pressure in a week, reconsidering the diuretic if the potassium stays low. She thanks you for finding the source.

name.zh-CN: 维持处方第2版（不含甘草）两周，饮食建议照旧，两周后复诊
name.en: Keep prescription version 2 (no liquorice) for two more weeks, with the same diet advice; review in two weeks

harm.zh-CN: 不能照旧续配：要么还没到复诊，要么他现在的第2版仍含炙甘草3 g——血钾已降到3.3，应开具不含甘草的第3版。
harm.en: Not continued as it stands: either this is not the review yet, or his current version 2 still contains 3 g of 炙甘草 — with his potassium down to 3.3, issue a version 3 without it.

response.zh-CN: 药房按第2版（不含甘草）续配两周（28包），标签核对一致。
response.en: The dispensary repeats version 2 (no liquorice) for two weeks (28 sachets); the label is checked against it.

name.zh-CN: 开具处方第3版：去掉第2版中余下的炙甘草3 g，其余不变；第2版作废（处方医师签名）
name.en: Issue prescription version 3 leaving out the remaining 3 g of 炙甘草, otherwise as version 2; version 2 cancelled (signed by the prescriber)

dose.zh-CN: 第3版：同第2版，去掉炙甘草；注明理由（复诊时血钾3.3、血压上升、水肿，另有凉茶与甘草梅的甘草摄入）；两周（28包）；第2版作废。
dose.en: Version 3: as version 2 without 炙甘草; the reason written on it (potassium 3.3 with rising blood pressure and oedema at review, and liquorice from herbal tea and plums as well); two weeks (28 sachets); version 2 cancelled.

harm.zh-CN: 只有当现行处方仍含甘草（第2版保留了炙甘草3 g）时，复诊才需要开第3版。
harm.en: A version 3 is needed at review only if the current prescription still contains liquorice (a version 2 that kept 3 g of 炙甘草).

response.zh-CN: 第3版已签发，药房确认收到，第2版标记为作废。
response.en: Version 3 is signed; the dispensary acknowledges it and marks version 2 cancelled.

name.zh-CN: 将处方第3版交药房调剂并发药
name.en: Release prescription version 3 for dispensing and supply

harm.zh-CN: 没有已签发的第3版可以调剂。
harm.en: There is no signed version 3 to fill.

response.zh-CN: 药房按第3版（不含甘草）调剂了28包，收回剩余的第2版药包，标签核对一致。
response.en: The dispensary fills 28 sachets from version 3 (no liquorice), takes back the version 2 sachets he has left, and checks the label against it.

title.en: Take the history and screen for alarm features

hint.zh-CN: 问清胀的性质与加重缓解因素，筛查体重、吞咽、呕吐、出血与家族史，并问清所有在吃的药和保健品。
hint.en: Establish the fullness and what changes it, screen weight, swallowing, vomiting, bleeding and family history, and find out every medicine and health product he takes.

guidance.en: Talk with Mr Ong in the consulting room.

title.zh-CN: 完成四诊与相关体格检查
title.en: Complete the four examinations and the relevant physical examination

hint.zh-CN: 望神色、舌，切脉，量血压，检查腹部。
hint.en: Inspect his spirit, complexion and tongue, take the pulse and the blood pressure, examine the abdomen.

title.zh-CN: 判断西医层面需要做什么，并作出中医辨证
title.en: Decide what the biomedical side needs, and differentiate the pattern

hint.zh-CN: 先看他带来的验血结果，再结合问诊与查体判断。
hint.en: Read the blood results he brought, then judge with the history and examination.

title.zh-CN: 开方、回应审方意见、发药并转介
title.en: Prescribe, answer the dispensary's query, supply and refer

hint.zh-CN: 药房对处方有意见时，看清楚，就这位病人的风险回答，回答落在新的处方版本上；之后再发药、写转介信、预约复诊。
hint.en: When the dispensary queries the prescription, read it, answer on this patient's risk, and put the answer into a new version; then supply, write the referral and book the review.

title.zh-CN: 两周复诊：解释血钾下降并处理
title.en: Two-week review: explain the falling potassium and act on it

hint.zh-CN: 看家庭医生的结果、胃镜报告与血压记录，量血压，问他这两个星期新喝、新吃的东西。
hint.en: Read the GP's results, the endoscopy report and the blood-pressure log, take his blood pressure, and ask what new things he has drunk or eaten these two weeks.

prompt.zh-CN: 在中医治疗之前，西医层面他的消化不良需要怎么处理？
prompt.en: Before any TCM treatment, what does his indigestion require on the biomedical side?

need.zh-CN: 先问体重、吞咽与呕吐、出血、家族史和用药，并检查腹部与面色、结膜。
need.en: First ask about weight, swallowing and vomiting, bleeding, family history and medicines, and examine his abdomen, complexion and conjunctivae.

text.zh-CN: 63岁新发消化不良、无报警症状：经家庭医生转介胃镜（非紧急），中医治疗可同时进行；因服噻嗪类利尿剂且血压未达标，同时请家庭医生复查血压与血钾
text.en: New dyspepsia at 63 without alarm features: refer through his GP for endoscopy (not urgent), with TCM treatment alongside; as he takes a thiazide and his blood pressure is above target, ask the GP to recheck blood pressure and potassium too

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。美国胃肠病学会与加拿大胃肠病学会2017年指南建议：60岁或以上的消化不良患者应做胃镜以排除上消化道肿瘤。他没有出血、吞咽困难、持续呕吐、体重下降或贫血，不需要急诊。
feedback.en: Correct. The ACG/CAG 2017 guideline recommends endoscopy for dyspepsia at 60 or over to exclude upper GI cancer. He has no bleeding, difficulty swallowing, persistent vomiting, weight loss or anaemia, so this is not an emergency.

text.zh-CN: 立即转急诊
text.en: Send him to the emergency department now

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有出血、梗阻或其他急症表现，生命体征平稳，不需要急诊。
feedback.en: No. There is no bleeding, obstruction or other emergency, and his observations are stable.

text.zh-CN: 功能性消化不良，不需要转介，只用中药
text.en: Functional dyspepsia: no referral needed, herbs only

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。60岁以上新出现的消化不良，在诊断功能性消化不良之前，应先做胃镜。
feedback.en: No. New dyspepsia at 60 or over needs an endoscopy before it can be called functional.

text.zh-CN: 先试用质子泵抑制剂，无效再照胃镜
text.en: Try a proton-pump inhibitor first, and scope only if it fails

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。先用药物试验的策略适用于60岁以下、无报警症状者；他63岁，应直接安排胃镜。中医诊所也不开质子泵抑制剂。
feedback.en: No. A trial of treatment first suits people under 60 without alarm features; at 63 he should go straight to endoscopy. Nor does a TCM clinic prescribe proton-pump inhibitors.

prompt.zh-CN: 综合四诊，最能被证据支持的证候是？
prompt.en: Bringing the four examinations together, which pattern is best supported by the evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先完成望舌、切脉，并问清加重缓解因素、胃口与大便。
need.en: First inspect the tongue, take the pulse and ask what makes it better or worse and about his appetite and stools.

text.zh-CN: 脾胃气虚，湿阻气滞
text.en: Spleen–stomach qi deficiency, with damp and qi stagnation

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。脾胃气虚：纳少、食后腹胀、便溏、神疲乏力、少气懒言、面色萎黄、舌淡胖齿痕、脉缓弱（右关尤弱）；喜温喜按、遇冷加重。苔白微腻、打嗝、胀满为湿阻气滞。方用香砂六君子汤加减。
feedback.en: Correct. Spleen–stomach qi deficiency: poor appetite, fullness after meals, loose stools, fatigue, reluctance to talk, a sallow complexion, a pale swollen tooth-marked tongue and a moderate, weak pulse (weakest at the right guan); better with warmth and pressure, worse with cold. The slightly greasy white coating, belching and fullness add damp and qi stagnation. Modified Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang fits.

text.zh-CN: 胃阴不足
text.en: Stomach yin deficiency

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胃阴不足多见口干咽燥、饥不欲食、舌红少苔、脉细数；他喜热饮、舌淡苔白。
feedback.en: No. Stomach yin deficiency brings a dry mouth and throat, hunger without wanting to eat, a red tongue with little coating and a thready, rapid pulse; he likes warm drinks and has a pale tongue with a white coating.

text.zh-CN: 肝胃不和
text.en: Liver–stomach disharmony

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肝胃不和多与情绪有关，胀连两胁、反酸嗳气、脉弦；他没有情绪诱因、没有反酸，脉缓弱。
feedback.en: No. Liver–stomach disharmony is tied to emotion, with fullness reaching the flanks, acid and belching, and a wiry pulse; he has no emotional trigger, no acid, and a moderate, weak pulse.

text.zh-CN: 脾胃湿热
text.en: Spleen–stomach damp-heat

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。湿热多见口苦口黏、苔黄腻、大便黏滞臭秽、脉滑数；他苔白、怕冷、喜热饮。
feedback.en: No. Damp-heat brings a bitter, sticky mouth, a yellow greasy coating, sticky foul stools and a slippery, rapid pulse; his coating is white, and he feels the cold and likes warm drinks.

prompt.zh-CN: 药房暂缓了处方第1版，对炙甘草6 g提出异议。你怎么回应？
prompt.en: The dispensary has put version 1 on hold, objecting to the 6 g of 炙甘草. How do you respond?

text.zh-CN: 接受意见的实质：开具处方第2版（去掉甘草，或减至3 g并写明监测），作废第1版，写明理由；请家庭医生两周后复查血压与血钾
text.en: Accept the substance of the query: issue version 2 (liquorice left out, or reduced to 3 g with the monitoring written on it), cancel version 1 and record why; ask his GP to recheck blood pressure and potassium in two weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。甘草酸致假性醛固酮增多症的风险随剂量与疗程增加，与噻嗪类利尿剂的失钾作用相加；他63岁、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘。在方中炙甘草只是调和诸药，去掉或减量都不影响主治。审方意见要就这位病人的具体风险回答，回答要落在新的处方版本上。
feedback.en: Correct. The risk of pseudo-aldosteronism from glycyrrhizic acid rises with dose and duration and adds to a thiazide's potassium loss; he is 63, with blood pressure above target and a low-normal potassium. In this formula 炙甘草 only harmonises the others, so leaving it out or reducing it does not change what the formula treats. A query is answered on this patient's risk, and the answer is a new prescription version.

text.zh-CN: 6 g在药典剂量范围内，照第1版调剂
text.en: 6 g is within the Pharmacopoeia range: dispense version 1 as written

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。药典范围是针对一般人群的，审方要看具体病人：排钾利尿剂、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘。
feedback.en: No. The Pharmacopoeia range is for people in general; a query is about this patient: a potassium-losing diuretic, blood pressure above target, low-normal potassium.

text.zh-CN: 请他吃中药期间先停氢氯噻嗪
text.en: Ask him to stop the hydrochlorothiazide while he takes the herbs

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。那是家庭医生开的降压药，他的血压本来就未达标；要改的是你自己的处方。
feedback.en: No. It is his GP's antihypertensive and his blood pressure is already above target; what you change is your own prescription.

text.zh-CN: 既然有风险，就不开中药了
text.en: If there is a risk, give no herbs at all

feedback.zh-CN: 不完全对。风险来自一味起调和作用的药，去掉或减量即可，不需要放弃整个治疗。
feedback.en: Not quite. The risk comes from one harmonising herb; leaving it out or reducing it is enough, without abandoning the treatment.

prompt.zh-CN: 复诊：胃胀好多了，但血钾降到3.3、血压上升、双踝水肿。第2版去掉了甘草或减到3 g。怎么看？
prompt.en: At review: the fullness is much better, but his potassium is down to 3.3, his blood pressure is up and his ankles are swollen. Version 2 left the liquorice out or cut it to 3 g. What is going on?

need.zh-CN: 先看家庭医生的结果，量血压，问清抽筋无力等症状，以及这两个星期新喝、新吃的东西。
need.en: First read the GP's results, take his blood pressure, ask about cramps and weakness, and about anything new he has drunk or eaten these two weeks.

text.zh-CN: 隐藏的甘草来源：每天一瓶廿四味凉茶加甘草梅，与噻嗪类利尿剂相加，出现低钾、血压升高、水肿、抽筋。停凉茶与甘草梅；确保他的处方不含甘草（第2版已去掉则维持，第2版保留3 g则开不含甘草的第3版）；当天告知家庭医生由她处理血钾与降压药；胃镜良性，继续调理
text.en: A hidden source of liquorice: a bottle of 廿四味 herbal tea every day plus liquorice plums, adding to the thiazide, with low potassium, higher blood pressure, swelling and cramps. Stop the tea and the plums; make sure his prescription contains no liquorice (keep version 2 if it left it out; issue a version 3 without it if version 2 kept 3 g); tell his GP today, who manages the potassium and the antihypertensives; the endoscopy is benign, so carry on treating the digestion

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。廿四味等凉茶多含甘草，甘草梅也是。处方去掉或减少了甘草，但总的甘草摄入要把处方、食物、饮料和保健品都算进去——药房担心的正是这个效应。体重增加1公斤、脚肿、血压上升、血钾下降，是典型的假性醛固酮增多症表现；如第2版仍有3 g，此时也应去掉。
feedback.en: Correct. Herbal teas such as 廿四味 usually contain liquorice, and so do liquorice plums. The prescription left the liquorice out or cut it, but total intake counts the prescription, foods, drinks and supplements together — exactly the effect the dispensary feared. A kilogram gained, swollen ankles, rising blood pressure and falling potassium are the picture of pseudo-aldosteronism; if version 2 kept 3 g, that goes too now.

text.zh-CN: 一定是中药引起的，全部停掉
text.en: It must be the herbs: stop them all

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。第2版没有或只有3 g甘草；停掉中药而不找来源，他会继续喝凉茶。
feedback.en: No. Version 2 has no liquorice, or 3 g; stop the herbs without finding the source and he will go on drinking the tea.

text.zh-CN: 是利尿剂的问题：叫他停氢氯噻嗪
text.en: It's the diuretic: tell him to stop the hydrochlorothiazide

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。那是家庭医生的药，血压已经更高了；找到并去掉甘草来源，再由家庭医生决定是否调整。
feedback.en: No. It is his GP's medicine, and his blood pressure is already higher; find and remove the liquorice source, and let his GP decide on any change.

text.zh-CN: 血钾只是略低，照常就好
text.en: The potassium is only slightly low: carry on as usual

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血钾在下降、有症状、有水肿，而且原因已经找到——今天就要处理。
feedback.en: No. The potassium is falling, with symptoms and swelling, and the cause is in front of you — act today.

text.zh-CN: 问清胀的性质、加重缓解因素、胃口与大便、寒热
text.en: Established the fullness, what changes it, appetite and stools, and cold and heat

text.zh-CN: 筛查报警症状与用药：体重、吞咽与呕吐、出血、家族史、药物与保健品
text.en: Screened alarm features and medicines: weight, swallowing and vomiting, bleeding, family history, medicines and health products

text.zh-CN: 完成望、闻、切诊（神色、舌、声音、脉）
text.en: Completed inspection, listening and palpation (spirit and complexion, tongue, voice, pulse)

text.zh-CN: 检查腹部与锁骨上淋巴结
text.en: Examined the abdomen and the supraclavicular nodes

text.zh-CN: 量了血压
text.en: Measured his blood pressure

text.zh-CN: 看了他带来的验血结果
text.en: Read the blood results he brought

text.zh-CN: 首次即正确判断西医层面需要的处理
text.en: Judged correctly, first time, what the biomedical side needs

text.zh-CN: 首次即作出有证据支持的证候判断
text.en: Reached the evidence-supported pattern assessment first time

text.zh-CN: 就这位病人的风险回应审方意见，并以新版本处方落实
text.en: Answered the dispensary's query on this patient's risk, and put the answer into a new prescription version

text.zh-CN: 没有以“在药典范围内”驳回审方意见，也没有叫他停降压药
text.en: Did not overrule the query as "within the Pharmacopoeia range" or tell him to stop his antihypertensive

text.zh-CN: 经家庭医生转介胃镜，并请复查血压与血钾
text.en: Referred through his GP for endoscopy, and asked for blood pressure and potassium to be rechecked

text.zh-CN: 交代用法与警示症状
text.en: Counselled on taking the granules and the warning symptoms

text.zh-CN: 复诊问清症状变化、新喝新吃的东西、抽筋无力与水肿、用药
text.en: At review, established his symptoms, anything new he drank or ate, cramps, weakness and swelling, and his medicines

text.zh-CN: 复诊量血压、体重并检查脚踝
text.en: At review, measured blood pressure and weight and checked his ankles

text.zh-CN: 首次即找到隐藏的甘草来源
text.en: Found the hidden source of liquorice first time

text.zh-CN: 停掉凉茶与甘草梅
text.en: Stopped the herbal tea and the liquorice plums

text.zh-CN: 复诊时确保他的处方不含甘草（第2版已去掉则维持；保留3 g则开第3版）
text.en: At review, made sure his prescription contains no liquorice (version 2 kept if it left it out; a version 3 if it kept 3 g)

text.zh-CN: 当天告知家庭医生
text.en: Told his GP the same day

text.zh-CN: 回应他对胃癌的担心，解释胃镜与处方的改动
text.en: Answered his fear of stomach cancer and explained the endoscopy and the prescription change

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 学员是否回应他因朋友患胃癌而来的担心，说明为什么要照胃镜、为什么不必急诊，解释处方为什么改了，并在复诊时不带责备地说明凉茶与甘草梅的问题？
judgeGuidance.en: Did the learner answer his fear, after his friend's stomach cancer, explain why he needs an endoscopy but not the emergency department, explain why the prescription changed, and at review explain the herbal tea and liquorice plums without blame?

text.zh-CN: 以专业的方式回应药房的审方意见
text.en: Answered the dispenser's query professionally

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 学员是否把审方意见当作安全核查而不是冒犯，就具体风险回应，说明修改与监测，并感谢药房？
judgeGuidance.en: Did the learner treat the query as a safety check rather than a challenge, answer the specific risk, explain the change and the monitoring, and thank the dispensary?

name.zh-CN: 蔡女士（中药调剂）
name.en: Ms Chua (TCM dispensing)

knowledge.zh-CN: 提出审方意见的调剂员。可说明甘草酸致假性醛固酮增多症的机制（水钠潴留、失钾、血压升高）、与噻嗪类利尿剂的相加作用、风险与剂量和疗程有关；香砂六君子汤中甘草只起调和作用；市售凉茶（如廿四味）与甘草梅等零食常含甘草。只就学员已得到的资料说明，不透露复诊结果。
knowledge.en: The dispenser who raised the query. Can explain how glycyrrhizic acid causes pseudo-aldosteronism (sodium and water retention, potassium loss, higher blood pressure), that it adds to a thiazide's effect, and that the risk depends on dose and duration; that liquorice only harmonises in Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang; and that commercial herbal teas (such as 廿四味) and snacks such as liquorice plums often contain liquorice. Explains only what the learner already has, and does not reveal the review's results.

misconception.zh-CN: 在药典剂量范围内就一定安全
misconception.en: A dose within the Pharmacopoeia range is always safe

say.zh-CN: 纠正一下：药典范围针对一般人群；他服排钾利尿剂、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘，要看他的具体风险。
say.en: Correction: the Pharmacopoeia range is for people in general; with a potassium-losing diuretic, blood pressure above target and a low-normal potassium, it is his own risk that matters.

name.zh-CN: 黄医生（综合诊所家庭医生）
name.en: Dr Wong (polyclinic family physician)

knowledge.zh-CN: 他的家庭医生，负责高血压、血钾与胃镜转介。不掌握中医四诊结果，除非学员告知。
knowledge.en: His family physician, responsible for his blood pressure, potassium and the endoscopy referral. Has none of the TCM findings unless the learner shares them.

name.zh-CN: 何医生（资深中医师）
name.en: Dr Ho (senior TCM physician)

knowledge.zh-CN: 资深注册中医师，督导学员。认为审方意见是安全网：回应要就具体病人讲理由，并落在新的处方版本上。不代替学员作决定。
knowledge.en: A senior registered TCM physician supervising the learner. Sees a dispensary query as a safety net: the answer gives patient-specific reasons and becomes a new prescription version. Does not make the learner's decisions.

name.zh-CN: Siti（诊所助理）
name.en: Siti (clinic assistant)

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责接待、量血压与预约复诊。不作诊断、不开方。
knowledge.en: Handles reception, blood pressure and booking reviews. Does not diagnose or prescribe.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：上腹胀满——药房的审方意见与隐藏的甘草
title.en: Debrief: epigastric fullness — the dispensary's query and the hidden liquorice

conclusion.zh-CN: 63岁新发消化不良、无报警症状：经家庭医生转介胃镜，结果为轻度慢性胃炎、幽门螺杆菌阴性。中医证属脾胃气虚、湿阻气滞，香砂六君子汤加减。药房对炙甘草6 g提出异议：他服排钾利尿剂、血压未达标、血钾偏低边缘。正确回应是就具体风险接受意见，开具第2版（去甘草或减至3 g）并请家庭医生监测。复诊时胃胀好转，但血钾3.3、血压上升、脚肿：来源是每天一瓶廿四味凉茶和甘草梅。停掉它们，维持第2版，当天告知家庭医生。
conclusion.en: New dyspepsia at 63 without alarm features: referred through his GP for endoscopy, which shows mild chronic gastritis without H. pylori. The TCM pattern is spleen–stomach qi deficiency with damp and qi stagnation, treated with modified Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang. The dispensary queried the 6 g of 炙甘草: he takes a potassium-losing diuretic, his blood pressure is above target and his potassium low-normal. The right response accepts the substance, issues version 2 (liquorice left out or reduced to 3 g) and asks his GP to monitor. At review the fullness is better, but his potassium is 3.3, his blood pressure is up and his ankles are swollen: the source is a daily bottle of 廿四味 herbal tea and liquorice plums. Stop them, keep version 2, and tell his GP the same day.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 60岁以上新出现的消化不良要照胃镜；先筛查报警症状决定急不急。
keyReasoning.en: New dyspepsia at 60 or over needs an endoscopy; the alarm-feature screen decides how urgently.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 脾胃气虚的依据：纳少、食后胀、便溏、乏力、少气懒言、面色萎黄、舌淡胖齿痕、脉缓弱；喜温喜按。
keyReasoning.en: Spleen–stomach qi deficiency: poor appetite, fullness after meals, loose stools, fatigue, reluctance to talk, a sallow complexion, a pale swollen tooth-marked tongue and a moderate, weak pulse; better with warmth and pressure.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 审方意见是安全网：就这位病人的风险回答，“在药典范围内”不是回答；回答要落在新的处方版本上。
keyReasoning.en: A dispensary query is a safety net: answer on this patient's risk — "within the Pharmacopoeia range" is not an answer — and put the answer into a new prescription version.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 改自己的处方，不停别人开的药。
keyReasoning.en: Change your own prescription; do not stop medicines someone else prescribed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 监测出现担心的效应时，把食物、饮料、保健品都算进去找来源。
keyReasoning.en: When monitoring shows the effect you feared, look for the source in foods, drinks and supplements too.

boundaries.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例。香砂六君子汤加减是多种可辩护方案之一。甘草酸含量因产品而异，病例中的风险描述为定性说明。复诊结果为编者设定。
boundaries.en: A fictional teaching case. Modified Xiang Sha Liu Jun Zi Tang is one defensible plan among several. Glycyrrhizic acid content varies by product, and the case describes the risk qualitatively. The review's course is authored.

unknowns.zh-CN: 一周后血钾与血压的变化。
unknowns.en: His potassium and blood pressure a week later.

unknowns.zh-CN: 家庭医生是否调整利尿剂。
unknowns.en: Whether his GP changes the diuretic.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 美国胃肠病学会与加拿大胃肠病学会2017年指南：60岁或以上的消化不良患者应做胃镜；60岁以下无报警症状者可先检测幽门螺杆菌或试用药物。
teachingPoints.en: ACG/CAG 2017: dyspepsia at 60 or over should be investigated with endoscopy; under 60 without alarm features, test for H. pylori or try treatment first.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 甘草酸可致假性醛固酮增多症：水钠潴留、失钾、血压升高、水肿；风险与剂量和疗程有关，与噻嗪类或袢利尿剂、皮质类固醇相加，高血压与老年人更敏感。
teachingPoints.en: Glycyrrhizic acid can cause pseudo-aldosteronism: sodium and water retention, potassium loss, higher blood pressure and oedema; the risk depends on dose and duration, adds to thiazide or loop diuretics and corticosteroids, and is greater in older people and those with high blood pressure.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 在新加坡，常见的隐藏甘草来源包括凉茶（如廿四味）与甘草梅、甘草橄榄等零食：问诊要点名问。
teachingPoints.en: In Singapore, common hidden sources of liquorice include herbal teas (such as 廿四味) and snacks such as liquorice plums and olives: ask about them by name.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 审方是调剂员的专业职责；回应时就具体风险讲理由，并记录。
teachingPoints.en: Querying prescriptions is the dispenser's professional duty; answer with patient-specific reasons, and record them.

notice.zh-CN: 评分衡量完成本教学路径的程度，未经临床能力评价验证。
notice.en: Scores measure completion of this teaching pathway and are not validated measures of clinical competence.

label.zh-CN: 叫血压未达标的患者停用降压药
label.en: Told a patient whose blood pressure is above target to stop his antihypertensive

label.zh-CN: 以“在药典范围内”驳回针对具体病人的审方意见（药房未放行）
label.en: A patient-specific dispensary query overruled as "within the Pharmacopoeia range" (not released by the dispensary)

label.zh-CN: 在回应审方意见之前、已有一个有效第2版时，或无需第3版时，尝试签发处方版本（已被拒绝）
label.en: A prescription version attempted before the query was answered, while another version 2 was active, or when no version 3 was needed (refused)

label.zh-CN: 试图照旧续配仍含甘草的第2版（或在复诊前续配）（已被拒绝）
